## participants
Q: which dataset has the full list of participating houses?
going from RN1 --> RN2 --> SO1: who's included, who isn't?
```{r}
# RN1 has every household/building number (e.g., 111111, 111112, 111113...)
length(unique(rn1$record_id))

# how many households in RN2?
length(unique(rn2$record_id))
## what do we know about the ones not in rn2?
rn1 %>% 
  filter(! record_id %in% unique(rn2$record_id)) %>%
  filter(rn1_rsdnt != 0) %>%
  filter(rn1_kids_nr != 0)
```
From 40124 houses in RN1 to 4186 in RN2...35,938 houses who did not participate but still live in the block/cluster.
- 7,427 of those aren't residential houses // leaving 28,511 who are residential houses but didn't answer RN2
- of those 28,511, 27,619 did not have any children // leaving 892 homes who had kids but didn't answer RN2

How many houses did we lose?
```{r}
# RN1 has every household/building number (e.g., 111111, 111112, 111113...)
length(unique(rn1$record_id))

# how many households in SO1?
length(unique(so1$record_id))
## what do we know about the ones not in so1?
rn1 %>% 
  filter(! record_id %in% unique(so1$record_id)) %>%
  filter(rn1_rsdnt != 0) %>%
  filter(rn1_kids_nr != 0) %>%
  filter(rn1_cnst_n1 == 1) %>%
  filter(is.na(rn1_cnst_tirs))
```
From 40124 houses in RN1 to 2711 in SO1...37,413 houses who did not participate but are still located in the block/cluster.
- 7,427 of those aren't residential houses // leaving 29,986 houses who are residential houses, live in the block/cluster, but did not participate in the study
- of those 29,986, 27,619 did not have any children // leaving 2,352 homes who had kids but didn't answer SO1 (and I'm guessing didn't participate in the study?)
- of those, 680 did not explicitly consent for N1 // leaving 1,672 who did, but didn't answer SO1/continue forward
--> do we know anything about them? why did they not continue? is this important information to know?

ok what are the block_id discrepancies then (in the three datasets i'm merging)
```{r}
so11 <- so1 %>%
  mutate(block_id = str_sub(record_id, 1,4))
entoo <- ento %>%
  mutate(block_id = str_sub(record_id, 1,4))
suss <- suspected_cases %>%
  mutate(block_id1 = paste0(CLUSTER, MZTIRS),
         block_id2 = ifelse(Source == "TIRS", str_sub(ID, 1,4), block_id1))

s1_blocks <- so11 %>%
  distinct(block_id) # 1,157 blocks
en_blocks <- entoo %>%
  distinct(block_id) # 1,150 blocks
su_blocks1 <- suss %>%
  distinct(block_id1) # 534 blocks
su_blocks2 <- suss %>%
  distinct(block_id2)

# are all the blocks from the cases in so1?
su_blocks1 %>%
  filter(! block_id1 %in% s1_blocks$block_id) # oh great 89 blocks didn't seem to participate
su_blocks2 %>%
  filter(! block_id2 %in% s1_blocks$block_id) #.....66 this time
# how about entomology?
en_blocks %>%
  filter(! block_id %in% s1_blocks$block_id) # 37 blocks have entomology information, but don't have so1 info

suss %>%
  filter(block_id1 != block_id2) # 124 cases (of just TIRS cases) have different block_ids than what their record_ids would indicate oh no

```
